limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the inverted write enable but also gated both RAM enables with reset, changing how the RAM handles a request when reset is asserted at a clock edge.
The reset test asserted reset on a falling edge and checked only the flags, so it could not detect the changed RAM behavior when reset and an eligible request coincide with a rising edge.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The prohibited cleanup command caused the entire test invocation to be rejected before simulation, requiring the harness setup to be resubmitted with a different cleanup method.
